label: Single-layer rules
subgoals: Decide whether the measurement is within one shape or between two
Match the measurement to width, spacing, notch or area

label: Two-layer rules
subgoals: Identify the inner and outer layer of the rule
Measure the margin on every side or end
Classify the rule as enclosure, extension or inter-layer spacing

label: Context-dependent rules
subgoals: Find the context the rule depends on: an edge's length, a window or connectivity
Compute that context before applying the threshold
Name the rule type from the context it needs
